title.en: White House orders federal AI rebranding and announces a voluntary frontier-safety accord
title.zhHans: 白宫要求联邦政府重命名 AI，并宣布自愿性前沿模型安全协议

searchSummary.en: Executive Order 14434 directed the U.S. executive branch to use “Super Intelligence” in place of “Artificial Intelligence” in non-statutory communications, while major AI companies signed a voluntary safety accord at the White House.
searchSummary.zhHans: 第 14434 号行政令要求美国行政部门在非法定文件与沟通中用“超级智能”取代“人工智能”；多家主要 AI 公司同时在白宫签署自愿性安全协议。

summary.en: Executive Order 14434 directed the U.S. executive branch to use “Super Intelligence” in place of “Artificial Intelligence” in non-statutory communications, while major AI companies signed a voluntary safety accord at the White House.
summary.zhHans: 第 14434 号行政令要求美国行政部门在非法定文件与沟通中用“超级智能”取代“人工智能”；多家主要 AI 公司同时在白宫签署自愿性安全协议。

narrative.en: The executive order is binding on executive-branch terminology and requests proposed legislative language, but it does not rename statutory references by itself. The accompanying industry accord describes internal controls, external auditors, and oversight committees, yet remains voluntary rather than enacted regulation.
narrative.zhHans: 该行政令对行政部门的术语使用具有约束力，并要求提出立法文本，但其本身不会改写法定术语。同期行业协议描述了内部控制、外部审计与监督委员会，但它属于自愿承诺而非已制定法规。

text.en: Executive Order 14434 directed executive agencies to use “Super Intelligence” terminology in non-statutory government communications.
text.zhHans: 第 14434 号行政令要求行政机构在非法定政府沟通中使用“超级智能”术语。

text.en: The order does not itself amend statutory terminology, and the accompanying industry safety accord is voluntary.
text.zhHans: 该行政令本身不修改法定术语，同期行业安全协议属于自愿承诺。
